# Wealth CRM Integrator Skill

> **Category:** Domain Skills > Industry > Wealth Management

## Overview

Use when integrating wealth management CRM systems including client data synchronization, workflow automation, activity tracking, and advisor productivity analytics for relationship management.

## Quick Start

1. Copy this skill folder to your workspace under `.github/skills/`
2. Reference in agent files: `skills: [wealth-crm-integrator-skill]`
3. The skill activates automatically when the agent is invoked

## Structure

```text
wealth-crm-integrator-skill/
  SKILL.md    # Skill definition with procedures and standards
  GUIDE.md    # This guide
```

## Companion Agent

This skill is designed to work with the `@wealth-crm-integrator` agent from the Independent Agents catalogue.

## Key Capabilities

- Synchronize client demographic and account data between CRM and custody/portfolio platforms
- Automate workflow creation for client lifecycle events: reviews, birthdays, milestones
- Track advisor activities: meetings, calls, emails for compliance books and records
- Configure opportunity management for prospect pipeline tracking

## Industry Standards Applied

- **SEC Books and Records (17a-4)**: Record retention for communications and client activities
- **FINRA Rule 3110**: Supervisory systems including activity monitoring
- **Reg S-P**: Data privacy for client information in CRM systems
